messages:
maria (pm): Need a crisp plan for v1 of streaming semantics. Customers keep asking: resumability, audit logs, and whether we support partial JSON + function calls out of the gate.
ajay (eng): My recommendation: v1 = streaming token deltas + stable finish_reason enum + best-effort short resume. Defer partial-JSON framing and function-call streaming to v2 to avoid scope creep.
sasha (platform): Ops question: if we provide resume tokens, what's the storage model? In-memory? cheap KV? That impacts cost at scale.
devon (ops): Prefer ephemeral KV with strict TTL (e.g., 2 minutes) and size caps per org. We'll need a replay throttling guard to avoid hot replays against busy endpoints.
leah (sdk): SDK constraints: mobile needs reconnect UX and a clear resume expiration. Web SDK can rely on SSE by default, but mobile SDKs should prefer WebSocket + HTTP fallback.
maria (pm): Proposed launch behavior for v1 (short list): 1) text deltas only; 2) finish_reason set: stop, length_limit, cancelled, error, timeout; 3) resume_token for reconnects <= 120s, best-effort; 4) SDKs must expose stream state (connected/resuming/failed). No streaming function-call semantics yet.
achoy (typo-bot): (no opinion)
ajay (eng): Implementation notes: runtime already streams incremental tokens and emits final metadata. We'll standardize the final event with model, model_version, finish_reason. Resume token shape: base64(request_id|last_seq|sig). Keep TTL short and stateless on the runtime side.
chris (cs): For enterprise audits we need a guaranteed final transcript and finish_reason attached to the stored transcript even if client never reconnected. Also want a way to request a replay from logs for investigation.
sasha (platform): We can persist the final transcript at completion to object storage (short-term) with ACLs for CS access. Replays should be gated behind per-customer rate limits.
leah (sdk): Edge-case: partial JSON chunks. For v1 we should clearly document: clients treat partial JSON as raw text; SDKs can offer optional auto-reassembly heuristics but must not assert correctness. This keeps server contract simple.
maria (pm): Launch criteria candidate: - Spec PR merged with examples - JS/Python SDKs: consumer pattern + finish_reason exposed - Mobile SDKs: reconnect examples + resume TTL handling - Telemetry: events for stream_start, delta, stream_end (with finish_reason) - Pilot with 2 customers for production validation
ajay (eng): Performance SLOs to add: p50 token emission latency under 40ms on hosted for common routes; 99th percentile reconnection resumption success above 80% for <=120s resumes in the pilot.
devon (ops): Also add monitoring: resume token hit/miss rate, replay volume, KV storage cost estimate. Runbook: how to revoke replay tokens for security incidents.
chris (cs): Add support criteria: when a customer reports missing final chunk, CS can request server-side transcript and finish_reason. That flow must be documented and automated where possible.
sasha (platform): Transport recommendation: - Hosted: default SSE for simple browser flows; enable WS for high-throughput low-latency routes - Dedicated/Private: default to WebSocket for persistent sockets and better resume semantics - Always support HTTP polling as last-resort for hostile proxies
leah (sdk): Example event shapes I'll ask the spec to include. Rough examples:```
data: {"event":"delta","req":"r_789","seq":12,"text":"hello "}
data: {"event":"end","req":"r_789","finish_reason":"stop","model":"redwood-prod-1","version":"2026-03-12"}
```
maria (pm): Vote check: proceed with v1 scope as above? +1 means go for spec PR this week.
ajay (eng): +1, keep structured streaming for v2.
leah (sdk): +1, will draft SDK guidance.
sasha (platform): +1, will include KV sizing and retention recommendations.
devon (ops): +1 with runbook item for token revocation.
maria (pm): Consensus. Next actions: ajay opens spec PR and includes finish_reason enum and resume token example; leah drafts SDK patterns and sample reconnect UI; sasha posts ops cost estimate and runbook; chris lines up pilot customers and acceptance tests. Timeline: spec PR by EOW, SDK guidance next week, pilots in ~3 weeks.
ajay (eng): I'll add unit tests that assert finish_reason values and final-event schema. Also include a note: streaming deltas are unordered per connection split, client should use seq to order.
leah (sdk): I'll include sample parsers and a caution about partial JSON parsing heuristics.
sasha (platform): I'll add telemetry retention/acl notes and estimated monthly KV ops.
maria (pm): Thanks. Tagging follow-ups: @ajay please cc @sasha on resume token RFC. @leah coordinate with @chris for pilot SDK testing. :rocket:
